32/S0.subgoal: Explain the concept of user-centric design and the need for a systematic approach to software development.

32/S1.subgoal: Explain the concept of software development lifecycles and use a calendar app example to illustrate the complexity of the design space.

32/S2.subgoal: Describe the iterative software development lifecycle required for interactive systems to account for user feedback.

32/S3.subgoal: Describe the specific stages and iteration patterns of the interactive system development lifecycle.

32/S4.subgoal: Summarize the key concepts of the interactive system development lifecycle and preview the next session.
